title: Recover a remote host or runtime change
steps: Detect the new daemon/workspace generation; mark old handles stale.
Preserve local drafts and the prior coherent projection.
Show the execution/model/vault map and the data boundary.
Verify runtime path, readiness and protocol compatibility.
Rebind the session and reconcile operations.
Resume only supported work; unknown effects stay visible.
forbidden_fake_states: Old handle controlling a new host
local URL shown as daemon loopback
replaying an old effectful request on a new host
complete_when: all callbacks and controls are fenced to the new binding; unknown effects stay visible (p.186).
